account_id.description: Your account number, for links to each incident.

base_url.description: API address, if not New Relic's own (a proxy, for example).

policies.description: Only violations of these policies (by name).

region.description: Where your account lives. Default us.

token_command.description: Command that prints the API key.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding a user API key. Default NEW_RELIC_API_KEY.

entries.description: Open New Relic alert violations, critical first, with the policy and how long each has been open. Links to the incident when account_id is set. Counts cover the first page of results (the API pages them). Built from New Relic's public REST API v2 docs (GET /v2/alerts_violations.json) and untested live.
entries.name: New Relic alerts
